items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 24 at 1:11PM PST until November 25 at 2:00PM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Tidal overflow flooding.

* WHERE...Central Coast of Oregon.

* WHEN...Until 2 PM PST Wednesday during periods of high tide.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding, up to one foot above ground level,
during high tides is expected in the low lying areas near bays,
sloughs, and the lower reaches of the coastal rivers.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...For the Central Coast of Oregon, the total
tides at Newport (South Beach) will 12.0 feet at 12 PM (Noon)
PST Wednesday November 25.
items.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Advisory means that tidal overflow flooding is
expected. Coastal residents in the warned area should be alert
for rising water, and take appropriate action to protect life and
property.

items.headline: The Coastal Flood Warning has been cancelled.
items.description: The Coastal Flood Warning has been cancelled and is no longer in effect.

items.headline: Storm Watch issued November 24 at 1:15PM PST until November 26 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Gale Warning, seas 17 to 22 ft at 15 seconds
and south winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt. For the
Hazardous Seas Warning, very steep and hazardous seas 16 to 21
ft at 14 seconds and south winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to
35 kt expected. For the Storm Watch, seas 17 to 22 ft at 16
seconds and south winds 30 to 40 kt with gusts up to 50 kt
possible.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR out 10 NM and Coastal waters from Cape Falcon to Cape
Foulweather OR out 10 NM.

* WHEN...Gale Warning, until 7 AM PST Wednesday. Hazardous Seas
Warning, from 7 AM to 1 PM PST Wednesday. Storm Watch, from
Wednesday afternoon through Thursday morning.

* IMPACTS...Very strong winds will cause hazardous seas which
could capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
A Storm Watch is issued when the risk of storm force winds of
48 to 63 knots has significantly increased, but the specific
timing and/or location is still uncertain.  It is intended to
provide additional lead time for mariners who may wish to
consider altering their plans.
